state.question: Each of A,B,C,D,E,F is a knight who always tells the truth or a knave who always lies. A says: B and C are of different kinds. B says: Exactly two of A,D,E are knights. C says: D is a knight if and only if F is a knave. D says: Exactly one of A,E is a knight. E says: B and F are both knaves. F says: At least three of A,B,C,D,E are knights. Which assignment is consistent?
